svg.aria-label: Experiment 07: the search read model is a pure projection, so it should be rebuildable by replaying events. It is — but only for events still inside Kafka's seven-day retention window. Catalog events emitted once at seed time have aged out, so an offsets-mode rebuild reconstructs them to zero. The gap is closed by re-emitting current state from the owning services instead.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: · the read side is derivable from events — up to a point

svg.text: search holds no authoritative state: drop search_db entirely and it should come back from the log. The experiment demonstrates the rebuild and delimits where the claim holds.

svg.text: Falsifiable: any projection row, reserved or version that differs after an ordered rebuild — or convergence even under reversed order, which would make the ordering concern moot.
